description: Bridges INotionCollaborationProvider observables to simple .NET events consumed by TmNotionCollaborationCursors and TmNotionPage. Owns join/leave lifecycle per page. Last-write-wins conflict detection: remote changes are always applied; the local block store is the source of truth for the current user's own edits.

members.name: BroadcastBlockChangeAsync
members.description: Broadcasts a local block change to all other collaborators.

members.name: BroadcastCursorAsync
members.description: Broadcasts the local cursor position to all other collaborators.

members.name: JoinAsync
members.description: Joins a page, subscribing to both streams. Automatically leaves any previous page.
